lock.title: Write out dependency locks for the configured providers.
lock.description: Write out dependency locks for the configured providers.

cacheEnabled.title: Enable plugin cache for lock operations.
cacheEnabled.description: Enable the plugin cache when locking providers. This speeds up the locking process but providers won't be loaded from an authoritative source. Requires cacheDir to be configured.

cacheDir.title: Terraform plugin cache directory
cacheDir.description: Optional: Directory where terraform will cache downloaded providers. If not specified, terraform uses default behavior (no shared cache).

mirror.title: Mirror providers to a local directory
mirror.description: Mirror providers to a local directory for offline installation. Can be combined with lock: true to lock and mirror providers in sequence.

mirrorDir.title: Mirror output directory
mirrorDir.description: Directory where mirrored providers will be written (used with mirror: true). If not specified, defaults to .terraform/providers.

platforms.title: Target platforms for provider operations
platforms.description: Target specific platforms for provider lock and mirror operations (e.g., linux_amd64, darwin_amd64). Used with lock and/or mirror flags.

root.description: Ad-hoc task override path to the Terraform working directory. Overrides project-level terraformRoot.
